thread:
eva (product): Quick sync — proposal for SOC2 evidence exports and per-tenant retention SLA. Key ask from two prospects: 1) per-tenant export within 24h, 2) ability to sample evidence for rolling audits (not full retention), 3) opt-in 7y ledger for regulated customers.

sam (eng): Can we meet 24h export without doubling storage costs? Current export job is daily bulk export to GCS. 24h should be ok but spikes are a concern.

nora (security): Auditability concern: sampled exports must still be cryptographically verifiable (hashes + chain-of-custody). We can't ship a sample that breaks traceability.

dan (sales): For the two POCs, 24h export + ability to mark certain tenants as "long-term" is a must-have. They'll pay for reserved capacity. Can product commit to a clear success criterion?

eva (product): Suggested launch criteria: (A) 24h per-tenant export working for 95% of requests under normal load; (B) export package includes manifest with sha256 hashes + signing key metadata; (C) an "evidence sampling" mode that selects deterministic sample sets by time window and seed.

sam (eng): Implementation notes: we can reuse the existing export pipeline but need: per-tenant ACL, manifest generation, and a sampling flag. Cost impact: incremental storage + CPU for hashing. Rough estimate: +8-12% infra for export-heavy tenants.

matt (infra): Also need to consider retention toggles in metadata so backups/archival policies don't prune evidence prematurely. We'll add per-tenant retention_label to the blob metadata.

nora (security): For signing, use KMS-backed signing keys. If tenant uses BYOK, we need to support customer-managed key sign-on-export OR provide a signed hash by Redwood plus an optional envelope signed by customer key.

dan (sales): That BYOK signing detail is fine as long as we document tradeoffs. POC customers expect a clear runbook for handoff to their compliance teams.

eva (product): Open questions for prioritization: 1) Do we gate long-term retention (7y) behind Dedicated/Private only? 2) Are sampling exports GA or limited to "compliance beta"? 3) SLA tiering (24h standard vs 6h premium). Thoughts?

sam (eng): Technical preference: 7y retention should be an enterprise-only feature (storage + legal). Sampling could launch in beta — simpler and less support burden. 6h premium adds operational complexity; prefer to start with 24h SLA.

nora (security): Beta is fine for sampling. For BYOK sign-on-export we need threat model doc + review. If we gate 7y behind Dedicated/Private, ensure encryption-at-rest and key-escrow policy clear.

dan (sales): Sales asks to expose a decision matrix in the spec: feature vs plan vs price. Helps close deals.

eva (product): Action items: @sam create a tech spec draft with manifest format + sampling algorithm (due Thu), @matt add retention_label to storage schema (due Thu), @nora start BYOK signing threat doc (due Fri), @dan collect POC runbook needs (due next Tue). If we get alignment, we'll slot this for Q2 product sprint.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync in #product tomorrow 10:00.

dan (sales): Thanks — will pull POC folks into a short call if necessary.

sam (eng): I'll sketch the export manifest sample here quickly:

```
manifest: {
  tenant_id: "t-123",
  generated_at: "2025-04-01T03:12:00Z",
  files: [
    { path: "evidence/2025/04/01/logs-1.gz", sha256: "...", signed_by: "redwood-kms:ver-1" }
  ],
  sampling_seed: "20250401-42",
  sampling_window: "2025-03-01..2025-04-01"
}
```

nora (security): That looks reasonable. Add a signed manifests endpoint and an audit event for export request + success/failure.

eva (product): Great — if no objections I will add these to the spec and circulate. Short follow-up: please flag any hard blockers by EOD.

sam (eng): no blockers from eng side.

matt (infra): no blockers from infra side.

dan (sales): no blockers. I'll surface to customers.

eva (product): Thanks all — moving to spec doc now.
